messages:
jordan: Main pipeline just flipped red on main after the merge of #4921. Smoke-GPU job failing with a kernel alloc OOM in the kv cache layer. cc @sam who merged. Error snippet below:
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:15Z] gpu0: alloc_map failed to reserve 25769803776 bytes: -12
[2026-03-17T14:02:15Z] fatal: kernel_alloc: out of memory allocating kvcache region
```
ci-bot: Pipeline: https://ci.redwood.local/runs/12345 — smoke-gpu step failed (exit 137). Logs attached. :warning:
sam: On it, pulling logs now. If rerun passes I'll escalate less. Triggering a rerun.
jordan: :eyes: If rerun fails, please bisect — this smells like the allocator tweak from the recent PR.
maria: I can run a local bisect in parallel on a smaller repro VM. Ping me if rerun doesn't help.
ops-bot: Rerun scheduled by @sam -> job 12346. Started.
sam: Rerun finished: failed same spot, same stack. Log shows `alloc_map: failed to reserve 24GB` during kvcache init.
lee: Could be cache size defaults bumped. Can someone try a targeted job with `--cache-size=1GB` to rule out pressure?
sam: Launching targeted job with reduced cache config now (job 12347).
ci-bot: Targeted job 12347 completed: failed with identical stack.
jordan: Ok, bisect time. @maria can you run `scripts/ci/bisect.sh --range=HEAD~10..HEAD --job=smoke-gpu` and report first bad commit?
maria: Starting bisect now on a smaller instance, will post updates.
sam: If bisect narrows it, let's prepare a revert for the offending commit and open a follow-up to fix allocator sizing.
maria: Bisect finished: first bad commit appears to be 7f9d2c3 (allocator: increase prefetch reserved window). It touches kv cache reserve logic. I'm adding notes on the commit and linking failing job.
jordan: :thumbsup: Please submit a revert PR and add the bisect output to the PR description. If revert causes immediate green, we'll cut hotfix. Moving discussion to #incidents if anyone wants to coordinate a revert rollout.
maria: Filed revert PR #4930 and linked logs + bisect output. CI for the revert is queued.
sam: Thanks all — I'll monitor the revert run and coordinate rollback if it goes green.
